high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for a carpentry course titled "Carpentry: Building Furniture with Hand Tools." The ad is sponsored by Domestika, as indicated at the top of the image. The course is taught by Israel Martín. The main visual element is a photograph of a wooden shelf unit with two open compartments and one drawer. The shelf is placed on a wooden surface, and in the background, there are some decorative items on a shelf, including what appears to be a bottle and a small sculpture or ornament.
